# SGL2

  <!-- badges: start -->
  [![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/Exceret/SGL/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Exceret/SGL/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
  <!-- badges: end -->

A modern implemetation of legacy SGL. Although both numerical stability and performance were taken into consideration, differences in the implementation may result in some discrepancies in the computed values compared with the original implementation.

## Installation

You can install the development version of SGL from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Exceret/SGL2")
```
